## README.md
# Field boundaries for Spain Canary Islands

Provides 466169 official field boundaries from Spain Canary Islands.
It has been converted to a fiboa GeoParquet file from data obtained from Gobierno de Canarias - Consejería de Agricultura, Ganadería, Pesca y Soberanía Alimentaria.

- **Source Data Provider:** [Gobierno de Canarias - Consejería de Agricultura, Ganadería, Pesca y Soberanía Alimentaria](https://www.gobiernodecanarias.org/agpsa/)
- **Converted by:** Ivor Bosloper
- **License:** CC-BY-4.0
- **Projection:** EPSG:32628

---

- [Download the data as fiboa GeoParquet](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/es-cn/es_cn.parquet)
- [STAC Browser](https://radiantearth.github.io/stac-browser/#/external/data.source.coop/fiboa/es-cn/stac/collection.json)
- [STAC Collection](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/es-cn/stac/collection.json)
- [PMTiles](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/es-cn/es_cn.pmtiles)

## Columns

| Property               | **Data Type** | Description |
|------------------------|---------------|-------------|
| id                     | string        | identifier  |
| determination_datetime | timestamp     |             |
| admin_island           | string        | Island      |
| crop:code              | string        | crop code   |
| crop:name              | string        | crop name   |
| area                   | float         | area in ha  |
| admin:country_code     | string        | ES          |
| admin:subdivision_code | string        | CB          |
| crop:code_list         | string        |             |
